system:
You draft public Twitter replies for Spotify's customer support account (@SpotifyCares), in 2017.

You will be given a customer's message and a numbered list of PRECEDENTS: real past customer messages with the reply Spotify actually sent. Your reply must be consistent with those precedents.

Hard rules:
- Ground every factual claim in the precedents. If the precedents do not establish something, do not say it.
- Never invent a policy, price, timeframe, refund, or entitlement.
- Never promise an action Spotify would have to take on the customer's account (refunding, resetting, unlocking, cancelling). You cannot see their account.
- If the precedents mainly ask the customer for more information, then asking for that same information IS the correct reply.
- Match the register of the precedents: warm, brief, lower-case-friendly, first person plural. Under 280 characters.
- If the precedents do not actually address the customer's problem, say so honestly in the `reply` and give a low confidence.

Return ONLY a JSON object:
{"reply": "<the reply text>", "confidence": <0.0-1.0>, "evidence_ids": ["<ids you used>"]}

`confidence` is how well the precedents support your reply, not how fluent it is.
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
how do I switch to annual billing? The page I was sent today doesn't seem to have any buttons :/ <link>

PREDICTED INTENT: billing_charge

PRECEDENTS:

[1706440] (similarity 0.46, intent billing_charge)
  past customer: why does charge monthly why cant it be yearly.
  spotify replied: Hi there! We don't have any info on this right now, but we'll let the right team know it's something you'd like to see

[62424] (similarity 0.46, intent billing_charge)
  past customer: The only reason I have not purchased premium is because of recurring billing. Is there any way around this?
  spotify replied: Hey there! Could you head over at <link> and see if that helps? For anything else, let us know

[155374] (similarity 0.44, intent billing_charge)
  past customer: hey there! I purchased a year subscription as a gift to be delivered on 11/18 and the email never was received. Could I please have it resent?
  spotify replied: Hi there! Can you let us know your account's email address or username? A screenshot of the receipt will also be super helpful. We'll take a look

[1875974] (similarity 0.42, intent billing_charge)
  past customer: like to change my billing date but due to be billed 2mro. Should I wait & pay before I cancel? Want to change to 26th of month
  spotify replied: Hi Elaine! You can change your billing date by following the steps here: <link> Hope this helps

[2309843] (similarity 0.60, intent subscription_manage)
  past customer: Hi how do I change my monthly subscription to a yearly one?
  spotify replied: Hey! Just select 'See more offers' on the Payments page. This should bring up the option to pay yearly. Hope that helps
